description: EPA ECHO (Enforcement and Compliance History Online) summary for one US state: counts of active facilities, inspections, formal enforcement actions and total penalties, from the ECHO REST service. Facility-level violation lists are not included. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_epa_flight_emissions when you need EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program reported emissions; energy_biofuel_rin_credits_epa when you need US EPA Renewable Fuel Standard RIN data from EPA's public. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
